items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: Paul told Jake Martin, he says, say what you do, he says, don't let that, whatever you do, don't let that guy get on the piano.

ctx.x: And he told me when they were at Fry's Inn in Chicago that Bix used to come around there.

Well, that was about 1921, 22. I guess Bix, Bix was quite young then. And he, it shows how much he liked the New Orleans musicians. He'd come around them and he used to want to sit in and he'd play in between when they'd be off the stand, he'd be on the piano, you know, playing around with the piano. He'd be on the piano, playing all these funny chords and everything. And then he wanted to sit in and play with them. So, with those chords that he was playing, these fellas, they couldn't, they couldn't, they didn't…
Well, where, where did, did Bix, could Bix play those kind of chords in the Whiteman Orchestra? I mean, was he able to work that out there?
